cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline AI tutor for Nigerian secondary school students preparing for JAMB, WAEC, and NECO exams. Runs fully on CPU with no internet required — targeting the 1.8 million annual JAMB candidates in areas with poor or no connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt: A JAMB Physics question: A stone is thrown vertically upward with an initial velocity of 20 m/s. Calculate the maximum height reached and the time taken to reach it. (g = 10 m/s²). Explain the concept tested and show the working.

Explain the process of photosynthesis as it would appear in a WAEC Biology exam. Include the light-dependent and light-independent reactions, name the products, and mention one common exam trap students fall into.
